title: An even-strand Markov calculus for classical and virtual links
theorem_scope: Explicit even-strand reversible schemes characterize ordinary oriented unframed classical and virtual link closures, answering the ordinary-closure interpretation of the literal dated 2014 Problem 42.
limits: Established unrestricted representation and Markov theorems are imported and explicitly credited.
No exhaustive absence of prior work, first priority, or present openness is claimed.
Fiedler's full counterexample proof was not obtained; the manuscript discloses the publisher-preview access limit.
The schemes permit arbitrary finite word blocks; uniform geometric locality, minimality, and certificate-search complexity are not asserted.
Finite computations corroborate the universal proof and are not a link-equivalence oracle.
AI tools were used extensively. This note is unrefereed, with no human peer review or formal proof certification.
